message.content:
- Horizontal overflow: Time slot cards (e.g., 9:00 AM/12:00 PM rows) may exceed 375px width, causing side-to-side scrolling.  
- Table/grid issues: 2-column time slot grids (e.g., Underarm Laser Waxing) risk overflow or misalignment on narrow screens.  
- Action button size: Small edit/delete icons in time slots may be too tiny for touch interaction.  
- Sticky header overlap: If header (e.g., "Time Slots" title, date picker) is sticky, it could cover top time slot content.
